boxes_client_matches_status.name: boxes_client_matches_status
boxes_client_matches_status.value:
("boxes"."status" = 'at_client' and "boxes"."current_client_id" is not null and "boxes"."issued_at" is not null)
        or ("boxes"."status" <> 'at_client' and "boxes"."current_client_id" is null and "boxes"."current_order_id" is null)

cash_entries_reversal_ok.name: cash_entries_reversal_ok
cash_entries_reversal_ok.value:
("cash_entries"."reversed_at" is null and "cash_entries"."reversed_by" is null and "cash_entries"."reversal_reason" is null)
        or ("cash_entries"."reversed_at" is not null and "cash_entries"."reversed_by" is not null
            and length(btrim(coalesce("cash_entries"."reversal_reason", ''))) > 0)

client_own_boxes_positive.name: client_own_boxes_positive
client_own_boxes_positive.value:
("client_own_boxes"."volume_l" is null or "client_own_boxes"."volume_l" > 0)
        and ("client_own_boxes"."capacity_kg" is null or "client_own_boxes"."capacity_kg" > 0)
        and ("client_own_boxes"."empty_weight_kg" is null or "client_own_boxes"."empty_weight_kg" >= 0)
        and ("client_own_boxes"."height_mm" is null or "client_own_boxes"."height_mm" > 0)
        and ("client_own_boxes"."width_mm" is null or "client_own_boxes"."width_mm" > 0)
        and ("client_own_boxes"."length_mm" is null or "client_own_boxes"."length_mm" > 0)

clients_merged_is_deleted.name: clients_merged_is_deleted
clients_merged_is_deleted.value: "clients"."merged_into_id" is null or "clients"."deleted_at" is not null

intake_messages_chat_message_key.name: intake_messages_chat_message_key
intake_messages_chat_message_key.where: "intake_messages"."telegram_chat_id" is not null and "intake_messages"."telegram_message_id" is not null

orders_confirmed_has_price.name: orders_confirmed_has_price
orders_confirmed_has_price.value: "orders"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or "orders"."is_archive" or "orders"."price_per_kg_snapshot" is not null

product_prices_current_box_uq.name: product_prices_current_box_uq
product_prices_current_box_uq.where: "product_prices"."valid_to" is null and "product_prices"."box_type_id" is not null

profiles_location_required.name: profiles_location_required
profiles_location_required.value: "profiles"."role" not in ('location_lead', 'production', 'driver') or "profiles"."location_id" is not null
